name: OPN-03 Volunteered details retained

expected_outcome: All volunteered fields are saved and normalized: plate 12345678, phone 0501234567, email dana@example.com, windshield. The lookup still runs and the vehicle must be confirmed. The agent does not ask again for contacts or add-ons and proceeds to a complete summary showing windshield; the final yes confirms it. After final confirmation, End Node sends the closing with the applicant name, normalized phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference. A UUID-shaped reference is correct and is not internal diagnostic output. The closing does not claim a policy was issued.
